samples.question: Dark is 1 and light is 0. Every square shows its ACTUAL value. XOR is 1 when inputs differ; AND is 1 only when both are 1; OR is 1 when either is 1. Each gate has a fixed hidden mode: NORMAL gives the named rule and INVERTED gives its opposite. Infer the modes from ACTUAL. In TEST, force the shown node to the shown bit, ignoring its incoming arrows. Keep the inferred modes at every other gate and recompute. What are P then Q? Answer 00, 01, 10, or 11.
